findings.interpretation: Outcome counts describe sensitivity on reused development episodes, not validation accuracy.
findings.limitation: Eight native positive-margin arms are incomplete; neither their missing outcomes nor real signal identities are inferred.
findings.observation: All 152 complete arms supply 41 episodes; 6232 saved episode-arm observations include 2334 unique, 904 ambiguous, 2427 insufficient, 291 multiple-persistent and 276 no-eligible outcomes.

findings.interpretation: A unique partition is not sufficient evidence of persistence.
findings.limitation: Smoothing and width change candidate eligibility; synthetic split/merge/recovery validation is not supplied by Stage36.
findings.observation: All smoothed-grid path families have exact cardinality one, yet none at widths 200–275 Hz has a persistent primary.

findings.interpretation: Status plateaus are weaker evidence than stability of membership.
findings.limitation: No universal threshold or configuration selection follows.
findings.observation: Status vectors are unchanged from 325 to 350 to unlimited in all 18 comparable families, while selected memberships still change in some smoothed-grid episodes.

findings.interpretation: Additional real primaries and zero structural violations cannot establish correct identity association.
findings.limitation: Historical fixture observations are separate evidence and are not rerun or extrapolated into representation-specific measured error rates.
findings.observation: Historical path fixtures retain 10/100 noise false primaries and eight crossing switches per method; Stage36 real truth metrics are not applicable.

historical_fixture_evidence.scope: Historical association-only fixtures; not new Stage36 observations or representation/width-specific validation

independent_emitted_path_constraint_chec.scope: All emitted possible path memberships in complete path arms; checks eligible membership, unique fragment, increments 1/2, step <=50 Hz, range <=100 Hz, support/coverage, and persistent support >=3 with coverage >=0.6. Does not re-enumerate retained hypotheses.

limitations: V1 measures dominant non-DC FFT-bin / fragment behavior, not carrier identity or device fingerprinting.
Six development captures; between-device evidence is descriptive only. Repeated arms do not provide independent replicates.
E07 and every negative, ambiguous, insufficient and computationally unresolved result are retained.
Real-data truth metrics are NOT_APPLICABLE; false-primary and identity-switch rates cannot be estimated from Stage36 real outputs.
Historical false-primary and crossing failures remain valid negative evidence. Full synthetic spectral matrix was not run by Stage36.
Eight unresolved native arms have no complete scientific summary; their saved partial output is not an approximation to the full arm.
Status stability does not imply candidate membership, cardinality, physical identity or external validity.
No ranking, score, gate-based selection, threshold tuning or runtime/memory quality score is supplied.

Frozen checkpoint adds a raw-output .gitignore rule absent from the older plan inventory; nine existing provenance tests error on this inherited mismatch. Scientific sources and raw hashes match their execution bindings.

measurement_definitions.diagnostic_retention: Eligible intervals containing the V1 strongest-bin frequency among the same 204 diagnostic-region reference fragments per arm. Not truth recovery.
measurement_definitions.fragmentation: All detected intervals intersecting [-5500,-5100] Hz, including ineligible intervals; independent of width filtering. Not physical splitting.
measurement_definitions.membership_comparisons: Sorted candidate-ID sets within a fixed representation; no cross-representation identity correspondence asserted.
measurement_definitions.persistence: Support >=3 and coverage >=0.6 of original episode fragments; persistent path counts are distinct possible memberships, not simultaneously existing physical signals.
measurement_definitions.power_retention: Unweighted fragment distribution of original unsmoothed regional power covered by eligible intervals; not a pooled power ratio.
measurement_definitions.statuses: Saved labels retained literally. MULTIPLE_PERSISTENT_TRACKS means jointly possible persistent paths in a retained hypothesis, not merely several alternative paths in the union. Connected uses its historical veto and does not emit the path status taxonomy identically.
measurement_definitions.unit: Episode-arm observations reuse 41 episodes / 210 fragments from six development captures; no independence implied.
measurement_definitions.unresolved: Eight arm-level states remain computationally unresolved; partial output paths retained for provenance, never substituted into complete-arm aggregates.
measurement_definitions.width_none: JSON null in width_hz and None grouping key mean unlimited.
